*.on_behalf_of: an argument on agent connections, named in notes about the caller
*.trophy_change: a loss on the arena's trophy floor carries trophy_change null: the note says the game omits the field
*.pre_reset: on a series row only at a season roll
*.pol_trophies: the profile's name for the board's rating, pointed at by rankings notes

elixir_changelog.tools_added: on an entry only when a version added tools

elixir_timeline.filed_at: Only an owner-visible account_feedback_responded item carries this field; the acceptance clan agent has no account-feedback answers. packages/tools/test/timeline-feedback-answer.test.mjs pins it on scratch account events.
elixir_timeline.answered_at: Only an owner-visible account_feedback_responded item carries this field; the acceptance clan agent has no account-feedback answers. packages/tools/test/timeline-feedback-answer.test.mjs pins it on scratch account events.
elixir_timeline.award_id: Only an attested award_standing item carries this field; a natural window may contain no leader-attested standings. packages/clan/test/standings.test.mjs pins the emitted fact. Never manufacture a live award for acceptance.
elixir_timeline.short_id: Only a nonempty canonical evidence page carries game short IDs. The dynamic contract reads naturally visible evidence within seven days; a quiet window has none. Invented scratch fixtures pin this conditional field; no production event is manufactured.
elixir_timeline.evidence_changed: A refusal reason of an evidence page read (docs/timeline, Recorded evidence). A healthy run produces none: evidence_changed appears only when a capture lands mid-read, so requiring it made the audit pass or fail by timing (2026-10-10). Pinned by packages/tools/test/timeline-evidence-refusals.test.mjs and timeline-evidence.test.mjs.
elixir_timeline.version_required: A refusal reason of an evidence page read (docs/timeline, Recorded evidence). A healthy run produces none: evidence_changed appears only when a capture lands mid-read, so requiring it made the audit pass or fail by timing (2026-10-10). Pinned by packages/tools/test/timeline-evidence-refusals.test.mjs and timeline-evidence.test.mjs.
elixir_timeline.evidence_unavailable: A refusal reason of an evidence page read (docs/timeline, Recorded evidence). A healthy run produces none: evidence_changed appears only when a capture lands mid-read, so requiring it made the audit pass or fail by timing (2026-10-10). Pinned by packages/tools/test/timeline-evidence-refusals.test.mjs and timeline-evidence.test.mjs.
elixir_timeline.left_at: departure_classified's optional detail (docs/timeline, the facts table): present only when a leader classified a departure with its time, and a quiet week has none, so requiring it made the docs audit pass or fail by what the clans did (deploy of 11.11.0, 2026-10-11). Pinned by packages/clan/test/manage.test.mjs (the attested fact carries left_at).
elixir_timeline.highlight_id: Only a battle_highlight item carries this field, and a highlight exists only once a member posts one (social slice 4, #762; none yet at its 2026-11-12 deploy). services/web-api/test/highlight.test.mjs and packages/tools/test/timeline-highlight-edit.test.mjs pin it on scratch data. Never manufacture a live highlight for acceptance.
elixir_timeline.share_url: Only the poster's own battle_highlight item carries this field, and a highlight exists only once a member posts one (social slice 4, #762; none yet at its 2026-11-12 deploy). services/web-api/test/highlight.test.mjs and packages/tools/test/timeline-highlight-edit.test.mjs pin it on scratch data. Never manufacture a live highlight for acceptance.
elixir_timeline.drawn_decks: On a battle_session's events[] entry only when that event's decks were drafted, picked or handed out (MCP 13.4.0): a run whose seven-day windows hold no draft or preset-deck event sitting has none, so requiring it made the docs audit pass or fail by what players played (first 13.4.0 deploy, 2026-11-17). packages/tools/test/timeline-tool.test.mjs (a challenge is told as a run) pins it on scratch battles.
elixir_timeline.run_wins: On a battle_session's events[] entry only for an event with a challenge win counter that reached at least one win (MCP 13.4.0); a window with no challenge sitting has none. packages/tools/test/timeline-tool.test.mjs (a challenge is told as a run) pins it on scratch battles.
elixir_timeline.from_name: On ranked.promotions[] only when a sitting climbed a Ranked league inside it (MCP 13.4.0; 3% of Ranked sittings, 2026-10/11); a window with no climb has none. packages/tools/test/timeline-tool.test.mjs (a ranked sitting's climb is told) pins it on scratch battles.
elixir_timeline.card_maxed: timeline: a kind written only when a member of the suite's clan takes a card to its top level between two profile reads (13.5.0, going forward only); a run's window may hold none. packages/ingest/test/profile-moments.test.mjs pins it on scratch rows.
elixir_timeline.king_tower_leveled: timeline: a kind written only when a member's King Tower level rises between two profile reads (13.5.0, going forward only); rare, so a run's window may hold none. Pinned by packages/ingest/test/profile-moments.test.mjs.
elixir_timeline.challenge_best_run: timeline: a kind written only when a member's best challenge run rises between two profile reads (13.5.0, going forward only); a run's window may hold none. Pinned by packages/ingest/test/profile-moments.test.mjs.
elixir_timeline.twelve_win_run: timeline: a kind written only when a member completes a 12-win Classic or Grand Challenge run (13.5.0, going forward only); rare, so a run's window may hold none. Pinned by packages/ingest/test/profile-moments.test.mjs.
elixir_timeline.best_before: on a challenge_best_run timeline item only, a rare kind
elixir_timeline.runs_before: on a twelve_win_run timeline item only, a rare kind
elixir_timeline.badge_count: on a badge_earned item only when it tells a day of several Mastery badges (13.5.0); a run's window may hold none. packages/tools/test/timeline-tool.test.mjs pins it.
elixir_timeline.three_crown_wins: on a sitting item only when it held a three-crown win (13.5.0); a quiet window may hold none. packages/tools/test/profile-moments-text.test.mjs pins its sentence.
elixir_timeline.deck_switched: timeline: a kind written only when a live battle-log read sees a member's third battle with a new deck in one mode (13.6.0, going forward only); a run's window may hold none. Pinned by packages/ingest/test/deck-switch.test.mjs and packages/tools/test/timeline-tool.test.mjs.
elixir_timeline.prior_deck: on a deck_switched timeline item only, a kind a run's window may not hold
elixir_timeline.overtime_wins: on a sitting item only when the tiebreaker decided one of its wins, a rare case (13.5.0). Pinned by services/web-api/test/home-feed.test.mjs and packages/tools/test/profile-moments-text.test.mjs.

players_names.in_corpus: on unknown[] rows, present only when a tag is unknown

war_current.points_earned: days_closed's per-day fields, absent until a war day closes

docs._: tokens the docs use as prose or as another surface's fields; each with its reason
docs.live_status: rides only on live: true reads, which the suite never makes
docs.observed_ip: operators page: owner-only console fields, never on the MCP surface
docs.filters_applied: documented as a key that does NOT exist
docs.notify_off: an account preference the timeline docs name, not a response field
docs.pol_league: the glossary's name for the profile's league field
docs.towers_before: on a battle row only when the record holds the boat/tower counters for that battle
docs.modal_arena: on trophy_floor only for a player with a floor in the window
docs.last_battle_at: on a `returned` timeline item, a rare kind
docs.player_activity: a timeline entry kind for a player subject; the acceptance principal is a clan agent and follows no player
docs.training_today: deprecated at 7.2.x (decks_today covers every race-week day); war_current serves it only on a training day, so a war-day run never sees it
docs.roster_and_war_only: an activity basis served only for an activity-scope clan (members' logs not recorded); a run over recorded clans never sees it
docs.account_role_changed: timeline: an account item written only when an admin changes the account's role; the suite's account has had none
docs.card_form_unlocked: timeline: a kind written only when a member of the suite's clan newly unlocks an Evolution or Hero form (9.14.0, going forward only); a run's window may hold none
docs.submit_retry: collector config transport policy, served by the collector door rather than MCP
docs.previous_name: on an attested award-standing timeline item only when first place changed hands
docs.previous_best: on an attested personal-record timeline item only when a previous best is supplied
docs.redirect_uris: quickstart OAuth registration/authorization/token exchange parameter; not a recorded-history MCP response field
docs.client_id: quickstart OAuth registration/authorization/token exchange parameter; not a recorded-history MCP response field
docs.redirect_uri: quickstart OAuth registration/authorization/token exchange parameter; not a recorded-history MCP response field
docs.code_challenge: quickstart OAuth registration/authorization/token exchange parameter; not a recorded-history MCP response field
docs.code_verifier: quickstart OAuth registration/authorization/token exchange parameter; not a recorded-history MCP response field

battles_query.king_tower_fell: a VALUE of inferred.duration.basis, not a field; the note explains the three rules

clans_participation.role_before: On members[].role_changes[] (full verbosity) only when a member's role changed inside the window; a quiet window has none, so requiring it made the docs audit pass or fail by what the clan's leaders did (2026-11-17). packages/tools/test/participation-history.test.mjs pins the change's fields on scratch roster reads.
clans_participation.window_start: same as role_before: the change's bracket, on role_changes[] only

elixir_cheers.well_played: A cheer id (docs/timeline#cheers, the table of the twenty): an item's cheers hold a kind's key only when someone gave that cheer in the window, so which ids a run sees is the day's data. services/web-api/test/cheers-rss.test.mjs stores and counts every id on scratch cheers, and elixir_cheers counts any id in CHEER_KEYS (packages/tools/src/activity/cheers.mjs). Never manufacture a live cheer for acceptance.
